state.question: Has Eastmere Debt Office's operating change resolved the question about real yield? Focus on: The ten-year real yield at September month-end and its change from August month-end.
state.conclusion: Eastmere issued inflation-linked bonds with a ten-year tenor.
state.gap: The ten-year real yield at September month-end and its change from August month-end.

candidates.title: Eastmere Debt Office: the measurement desk
candidates.abstract: An edited digest of Leila Moss's Dispatch's dispatch on Eastmere Debt Office, retaining its reported comparison and attribution.

candidates.title: Eastmere Debt Office: the weekly notebook
candidates.abstract: Eastmere Debt Office fixing sheet supports a dated assessment of the ten-year real yield at September month-end and its change from August month-end.

candidates.title: Eastmere Debt Office: the operating record
candidates.abstract: Eastmere Debt Office features in a field guide to real yield. The worked example draws on a separate setting: an investment brochure explains real yields using a one-year deposit example.

candidates.title: Eastmere Debt Office: what the announcement changes
candidates.abstract: Our reporting desk follows Eastmere Debt Office, drawing on an independent correspondent's account of the ten-year real yield at September month-end and its change from August month-end.

candidates.title: Eastmere Debt Office: the strategic argument
candidates.abstract: A commentary revisiting Eastmere Debt Office's operating announcement, carrying the same factual account as the public record.

candidates.title: Eastmere Debt Office: the latest field dispatch
candidates.abstract: I set out the case for Eastmere Debt Office's strategy in real yield, using incentives and managerial judgement to project the next stage.
